title: Salvianolic acid C attenuates liver fibrosis and inhibites hepatic stellate cell activation by targeting FAP/TbetaRI/SMAD axis.
authors: Sun, Tao; Zheng, Xue; Li, Liang; Chu, Jin; Guo, Qiang; Yang, Ning; Zhang, Xue; Li, Xiaotong; Shi, Bowen; Zhang, Hongbin; Lu, Guodong; Cheng, Lufeng; Lin, Renyong; Bi, Xiaojuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究丹酚酸C通过靶向FAP/TbetaRI/SMAD轴抗肝纤维化，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白作用而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Liver fibrosis remains a major clinical challenge with limited effective therapeutic options. Salvianolic acid C (SAC), a major water-soluble compound derived from Salvia miltiorrhiza, has shown anti-fibrotic activity in various disease models; however, its role and underlying mechanisms in liver fibrosis remain unclear. METHODS: A CCl(4)-induced mouse model was used to assess the in vivo anti-fibrotic activity of SAC. LX-2 hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) were used to investigate the underlying mechanisms in vitro. Network pharmacology, machine learning, molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations were integrated to identify potential targets. Western blotting and immunohistochemistry were used to validated the key findings in vitro and in vivo. RESULTS: SAC significantly reduced collagen deposition and alleviated hepatic injury in CCl(4)-induced murine models. It also inhibited the expression of Col1a1, alpha-SMA, and Timp1 both in vivo and in vitro. FAP was implicated as a potential target of SAC, and SAC promotes FAP degradation in HSCs, thereby reducing FAP protein levels and inhibiting HSC activation in a FAP-dependent manner. SAC treatment significantly downregulated TbetaRI expression and inhibited SMAD phosphorylation, and these effects were attenuated by FAP overexpression. CONCLUSIONS: SAC attenuated liver fibrosis and inhibited HSC activation by targeting FAP to suppress the TbetaRI/SMAD signaling pathway. This finding underscores its potential as a therapeutic agent for liver fibrosis and provides a basis for further drug development.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝纤维化仍是临床上的重大挑战，有效治疗选择有限。丹酚酸C（Salvianolic acid C, SAC）是从丹参（Salvia miltiorrhiza）中提取的主要水溶性化合物，已在多种疾病模型中显示出抗纤维化活性；然而，其在肝纤维化中的作用及潜在机制尚不清楚。方法：采用CCl(4)诱导的小鼠模型评估SAC的体内抗纤维化活性。使用LX-2肝星状细胞（hepatic stellate cells, HSCs）在体外研究其潜在机制。整合网络药理学、机器学习、分子对接和分子动力学模拟以识别潜在靶点。通过Western blotting和免疫组织化学在体内和体外验证关键发现。结果：SAC显著减少CCl(4)诱导小鼠模型中的胶原沉积并减轻肝损伤。它还在体内和体外抑制Col1a1、alpha-SMA和Timp1的表达。FAP被确定为SAC的潜在靶点，SAC促进HSCs中FAP降解，从而降低FAP蛋白水平并以FAP依赖性方式抑制HSC活化。SAC处理显著下调TbetaRI表达并抑制SMAD磷酸化，而这些效应被FAP过表达所减弱。结论：SAC通过靶向FAP抑制TbetaRI/SMAD信号通路，减轻肝纤维化并抑制HSC活化。这一发现强调了其作为肝纤维化治疗药物的潜力，并为进一步药物开发提供了基础。
